source.instruction: 按照这个步骤开始实现吧
source.accepted_plan: Finish Debug UI evidence/review; separate Undo/Redo package; Application owner EditorHistory; RuntimeFacade consumers; Windows Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y; verify semantic/pixel restoration, generations, fresh identities, redo clearing and empty history.

trusted_statements.owner: InkPlaygroundHost application composition owns local EditorHistory and submits ordinary typed compensating Operations through OperationEngine.
trusted_statements.acceptance: OperationEngine kApplied is semantic acceptance. Failed derived Scene publication/presentation never reports an accepted mutation as side-effect-free rejection. Projection recovery is separate; further history commands require coherent Scene.
trusted_statements.inverse: AddStroke -> DeleteObjects; object erase -> exact RestoreObjects preimage; partial erase -> exact RemoveEraseMasks identities.
trusted_statements.ui: RuntimeFacade carries product actions and canUndo/canRedo; Debug UI owns no history, document or surface state.
preserve: Canonical operation vocabulary and apply semantics

prior_debug_ui_review.release_dependency: Unresolved; this package does not close Debug UI P32 or issue a Gate verdict.
